rules: Anonymous public availability does not establish authenticated GitLab restoration.
Rendered GitLab Pages output is not exact source recovery unless a verifiable GitLab source object and byte identity are independently established.
Never reconstruct unavailable GitLab source/template bytes from rendered HTML, search snippets, chat memory, or screenshots.
If exact GitLab provenance is later recovered, record the GitLab object path/id, source SHA, retrieval date and byte/parity result before upgrading classification.
Outage-period GitHub work is reconciled additively and is never force-reset away when GitLab returns.
